# Tech Lounge

> > Tech Lounge provides beginner-friendly tutorials and step-by-step guides for creative software including Adobe Creative Suite, Notion, Procreate, and design tools.

Tech Lounge focuses on practical how-to content for digital creators, covering graphic design, video editing, productivity apps, and digital art workflows. The site emphasizes accessibility for beginners while covering professional tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and productivity platforms like Notion and Slack.

## Adobe Photoshop Tutorials

- [How to Crop a Layer in Photoshop](https://techloungesp.com/crop-layer-photoshop): Guide to cropping layers using Photoshop tools and Layer Masks
- [How to Duplicate in Photoshop](https://techloungesp.com/duplicate-photoshop): Tutorial on layer duplication using Clone Stamp and keyboard shortcuts
- [How to Draw Straight Lines in Photoshop](https://techloungesp.com/draw-straight-line-photoshop): Beginner guide to Photoshop Line Tool, Pen Tool, and Shift key techniques

## Adobe Illustrator & InDesign Guides

- [How to Make Dashed Lines in Illustrator](https://techloungesp.com/dashed-lines-illustrator): Adobe Illustrator tutorial for creating dashed lines with Stroke panel
- [How to Rotate Artboard in Illustrator – 2 Easy Steps](https://techloungesp.com/rotate-artboard-illustrator): 2-step tutorial for rotating artboards using Illustrator's Rotate View Tool
- [How to Wrap Text in InDesign](https://techloungesp.com/wrap-text-indesign): InDesign Text Wrap panel tutorial for desktop publishing formatting
- [How to Underline Text in InDesign](https://techloungesp.com/underline-text-indesign): Adobe InDesign text formatting guide for underlining and strikethrough

## Video Editing Tutorials

- [How to Crop Video in Premiere Pro](https://techloungesp.com/crop-video-premiere-pro): Beginner tutorial for video cropping in Adobe Premiere Pro Effects Panel
- [How to Edit on Capcut Step-by-Step](https://techloungesp.com/edit-capcut): Step-by-step CapCut video editing guide for social media content
- [How to Duplicate Layers in After Effects – 3 Easy Steps](https://techloungesp.com/duplicate-layers-after-effects): 3-step beginner guide to duplicating layers in Adobe After Effects

## Digital Art & Illustration

- [How to Mirror in Procreate](https://techloungesp.com/mirror-in-procreate): Guide to using Procreate's Symmetry Tool and Drawing Guide on iPad
- [How to Erase on Procreate](https://techloungesp.com/how-to-erase-on-procreate): Procreate eraser tool tutorial covering settings and Apple Pencil techniques
- [How to Make GIFs in Clip Studio Paint](https://techloungesp.com/gif-clip-studio-paint): Animated GIF creation tutorial with CSP timeline and onion skinning
- [How to Remove Background in Inkscape](https://techloungesp.com/remove-background-inkscape): Tutorial on background removal and vectorization with Inkscape Bezier tool
- [How to Use Inkscape on Mac with Xquartz](https://techloungesp.com/xquartz-inkscape): Installation guide for running Inkscape on macOS using XQuartz

## Notion Productivity Guides

- [How to Make a Template in Notion](https://techloungesp.com/template-notion): Tutorial on creating custom templates in Notion for productivity workflows
- [How to Make Columns in Notion](https://techloungesp.com/columns-notion): Beginner guide to creating column layouts in Notion via drag-and-drop
- [How to Undo on Notion](https://techloungesp.com/undo-notion): Notion undo/redo keyboard shortcuts for Windows and Mac productivity

## PDF & Document Tools

- [How to Add Fonts to Adobe Acrobat](https://techloungesp.com/add-fonts-adobe-acrobat): Tutorial on installing and customizing fonts in Adobe Acrobat PDFs
